Bullet Physics 2.77, from bullet-2.77.tgz (Google Code archive,
code.google.com/archive/p/bullet).

Only LinearMath, BulletCollision, BulletDynamics, BulletSoftBody and the
top-level headers of src/ are included. src/ is renamed Bullet/ so the
"Bullet/..." includes in irrBullet resolve against this copy. Project
and build files from the release are left out.

Altered source:
  Bullet/BulletSoftBody/btSoftBodyInternals.h
    ZeroInitialize() clears the value with memset instead of copying a
    default-initialised static const object, which current compilers
    reject for types without a user-provided default constructor.
